title: Frog Corruption
description:
makes minecraft really hard
(might make it impossible)
body:
ever tought that minecraft was too easy?

 

well uh

your gonna have a rough time beating this mod to say the least.

 

anyways this mod makes minecraft i think impossible idk

but uhm it adds cool frogs called frlobs i guess

and also they 1 shot you ;)

(except for the evil frlob, you'll see why i made him not 1 shot you)

 

i don't want to spoil a lot but there are end frlobs that spawn in the end and you guessed it! they 1 shot you...

there's uh normal frlob and evil frlob that spawn in the overworld

 

i don't yap much so i hope this is enough information.
